prompt:
Desktop landing page first viewport, 1536x1024, for "lll", a self-hosted Linear-style issue tracker driven from the terminal, built so many coding agents on many machines and in many harnesses share one live board. Keep the exact visual identity of the reference screenshots: saturated ember orange #f0883e band with near-black ember ink #1a0f06 type, Inter heavy display type at weight 800 with tight tracking, and an instrument-panel dark section (#0e0f11 ground, #191c20 raised cards, hairline white-alpha borders, 6px radii, monospace terminal blocks, small drawn state circle icons: yellow in-progress #e0b13e, violet in-review #8d7ce6, green done #4cb782). Small top bar: "lll" mark left; Source, Docs, Latest release right. Crisp, production-grade UI rendering, legible real text, no stock photos, no gradients, no glow, no 3D, no people.
STRUCTURE "Two doors, one board": the hero is split down the middle by a thin vertical seam. Left door on orange: label "ON YOUR MACHINE", big headline "lll up", a terminal line "$ brew install escherize/lll/lll && lll up". Right door on near-black: label "ONLINE", big headline "One binary. One volume.", line "$ fly deploy". Above both, spanning, the headline "One board for every agent." Below the doors, both paths converge with thin hairline arrows into one wide dark board screenshot (six columns Backlog, Todo, In progress, In review, Done, Cancelled; cards like "ENG-12 Fix upload retry" claimed by bot-codex, "ENG-14 Board rail spacing" by bot-claude). Along the arrows small dark pill chips: "Claude Code", "Codex", "pi", "opencode", "CI script", each with a tiny machine name like "laptop", "ci-runner", "homelab". A small "1.0" tag near the headline.
